genesis.observed_development_fact: the pre-registered loser portfolio had active_mean=-0.0056802513 and HAC_t=-3.137 at 40bps
genesis.consequence: the momentum sign is post-development hypothesis generation; its development p-value cannot be used as confirmation

claim_boundary: the direction was generated after observing the 2022-2023 reversal failure
development statistics are descriptive and forbidden as confirmation
the 2024plus segment was not opened for this direction before protocol freeze but remains retrospective, not independent OOS
a pass creates a candidate for a separate self-financing daily path and prospective forward test only
a failure closes this exact momentum definition without lookback, neutralization, target-size, buffer, or holding-period rescue

mechanism.hypothesis: industry- and size-neutralized one-week winners continue over the next week after realistic membership turnover costs

signal.raw_return: decision close divided by the fifth prior observed stock close minus one
signal.winsorization: within decision date at 1st and 99th percentiles for raw return and log free-float market cap
signal.neutralization: weekly OLS raw_return ~ intercept + zscore(log_free_float_mcap) + SW2021_L1 industry dummies with deterministic sorted columns
signal.score: positive OLS residual so the most idiosyncratically strong winner ranks first

portfolio.recursive_membership: retain previous names if current momentum rank<=75, then fill by momentum rank and symbol
portfolio.outcome: fifth common market-session open return from entry
portfolio.missing_or_untradable_selected_slot: zero return cash proxy and separately report completeness

benchmark.definition: same-week equal-weight mean fwd_5d_open_return of every finite entry-tradable eligible stock

statistics.estimand: weekly candidate net return minus theoretical all-eligible gross benchmark return

decision_rules.development_descriptive_gate: same numerical rules are reported only as a sanity check; because the sign was selected from development, this gate has no confirmatory weight
decision_rules.validation_pass: mean active net return>=0.25% weekly; one-sided HAC p<0.05; block-bootstrap q05>0; both locked validation-half active means>0; candidate net mean>0; observable target slot rate>=98%; compounded candidate max drawdown<=35%
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp roundtrip the validation active mean and block-bootstrap q05 remain positive
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_MOMENTUM_CANDIDATE_DAILY_PATH_AND_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if locked validation and 60bp stress pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_LOCKED_VALIDATION; no alternate lookbacks, neutralizers, target sizes, buffers, or holding horizons in this study
